subject: general
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

PI-MF-KN

SL-PI-NQ
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Alphabetical position change**

From the **1st pair → 2nd pair → 3rd pair**

 
• 
 
**First letters:** decrease by **3** each step

 
 
• 
 
**Second letters:** increase by **3** each step

 

**Given,**

PI – MF – KN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f59ad992afc43be128ea02eff51bca1f1642dc0763e48e3a203873a75539ffdd.png] 

 

SL – PI – NQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f719122be7fa50ee989708f95f6fe0484cf3393483876ea8cfc1344d6f2ef6d8.png] 

Now, checking the options:

**Option 1) VO – SL – QT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c476fa100087b780915f2268c8dd01d426f5ff69188c2d6733783de8ac7b65.png] 

**Option 2) WO – SK – QU**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb05994a66113a24bb6e94242688b68d165b01955925115f75ef281643b48c05.png] 

**Option 3) WO – SL – QU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8114506b2fff687c84701a1492989710d4e4d0840b9b628019046b9d32a8d7e7.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41a44bd1ea94018e56629f1685f5925f4f9f55a30bc0248dabea0a940df26249.png]
